response.overview: To contact Priceline for a billing dispute, duplicate charge, or general customer support, you can reach them through the Priceline Customer Service Help Center or by phone.Official Contact Options Primary Customer Service Phone: Call 1-877-(254)-3016 (or 1-877-Priceline) for live assistance with bookings, charges, and cancellations. Alternative Toll-Free Numbers: 1-877-(254)-3016 1-877-(254)-3016 (billing and support line)
